name: Two birch ply wardrobes either side of a chimney breast, Chiswick, as built
source: Built 19 Oct 2026 with the su-helpers.py functions run locally (scripts/wardrobe/local.py), from the architect's drawings in the Job Kit request (Front Bedroom options 01F and 01E, 17/10/26): wardrobes 1160 wide, chimney breast 1630, 2550 high, drawer zone 600 (01F) or 800 (01E). Standard: 600 deep, breast 380 deep, plinth 110, shelf heights read off the drawing. Updated 23 Nov 2026 to match the finished job (Raf): no side niches, round finger holes in every door and drawer front, the two reading lights fixed on the wardrobe sides with heads that turn and glow, three black straps under each of the two shelves over the lights, and the shelf at 800 joined to the lower panel as one piece that lifts out, with a finger slot at the floor. Hole, strap, lamp and slot sizes are read off the photos.

actions.open: Open the doors, turn the lamps
